استهبلن (form X)
# اِسْتَهْبَلْنَ (istahbalna) /is.tah.bal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
# اِسْتَهْبِلْنَ (istahbilna) /is.tah.bil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَهْبَلَ (istahbala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
